cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.27)

project(apriltag)

# 定义项目版本号宏
set(PROJECT_VERSION_MAJOR 1)
set(PROJECT_VERSION_MINOR 0)
set(PROJECT_VERSION_PATCH 0)

# 生成版本号字符串
set(PROJECT_VERSION "${PROJECT_VERSION_MAJOR}.${PROJECT_VERSION_MINOR}.${PROJECT_VERSION_PATCH}")

message(STATUS "Project Name: ${PROJECT_NAME}")
message(STATUS "Project version: ${PROJECT_VERSION}")
message(STATUS "Project Dir: ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")

# file(GLOB FILES_SRC_APRILTAG ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*.c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/common/*.c)
# file(GLOB FILES_HEADERS_APRILTAG ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*.h ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/common/*.h)

aux_source_directory(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/common COMMON_SRC)

set(APRILTAG_SRCS
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/apriltag.c
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/apriltag_pose.c
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/apriltag_quad_thresh.c)

# Library
file(GLOB TAG_FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tag*.c)

add_library(${PROJECT_NAME} SHARED ${APRILTAG_SRCS} ${COMMON_SRC} ${TAG_FILES})
set_target_properties(${PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTIES VERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION} SOVERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION_MAJOR})

target_include_directories(${PROJECT_NAME}
        PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/common
        )

install(TARGETS ${PROJECT_NAME}
        ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib/${PROJECT_NAME}
        LIBRARY DESTINATION lib/${PROJECT_NAME}
        RUNTIME DESTINATION bin/${PROJECT_NAME})
